claims: The 2026 World Baseball Classic Championship game is between Venezuela and Team USA.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic Championship game is on Tuesday, March 17, 2026, at 8 p.m. ET.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic final match will be held at loanDepot Park in Miami, FL.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic final match will be televised on FOX.
USA defeated the Dominican Republic in the semifinals.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic featured 20 teams.
